 Overview

 Polar Client preactivated — Hypixel Skyblock Mithril, Gemstone, Powder & Commission Macro (2026 Edition) ( polar-client-skyblock-mining-2026 ) is a modular, low-overhead runtime and configuration suite engineered for 64-bit Windows 10 and Windows 11 systems. All parameters are controlled cleanly through config/settings.json with live hot-reload support and zero external dependencies.

 [!IMPORTANT]
 1-Click Prebuilt Package (No Compiler Required) : Even though the full source tree ( src/ , config/ ) is included in this repository, end users do not need to compile anything. Click the green Download Portable Release button above or grab polar-client-skyblock-mining-2026-v1.2.0-win64.zip directly from Releases .
